channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Ashton: Trade Truce Will Be Key Test of Trump-Xi Talks
item.description: Anna Ashton, Co-Founder of Ashton Intelligence, says extending the US-China trade truce will likely be a central issue when President Trump meets Chinese President Xi Jinping. Ashton says the length of any extension matters as China retains leverage through restrictions on rare-earth exports. She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Rep. Malliotakis Says China Is ‘An Ally, an Adversary’
item.description: Rep. Nicole Malliotakis (R-NY) says China is “in some ways an ally, in some ways an adversary” as the US and China compete over artificial intelligence. Rep. Malliotakis says talks with Beijing over an AI framework are worthwhile, but questions whether China can be trusted to follow one. She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AI & Chip Stocks Lead Markets Higher
item.description: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are DWS Group Global CEO Stefan Hoops, Guggenheim Senior Managing Director Michael Morris, Whole Foods Market CEO Jason Buechel, Aldi U.S. Chief Operating Officer Dave Rinaldo, Partners Group Chief Investment Strategist Anastasia Amoroso, CVC Marathon Head & Managing Partner Bruce Richards, Qualcomm CFO & COO Akash Palkhiwala, Qantas CEO Vanessa Hudson, Finland President Alex Stubb, & UN Foundation President & CEO Elizabeth Cousens. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump Pageantry for Xi Will Mask Feud Over US-China AI Race
item.description: Donald Trump welcomes Xi Jinping to Washington for a state visit focused more on pageantry than policy, looking beyond long-standing feuds between the world’s biggest economies.
item.dc:creator: Josh Wingrove, Nectar Gan and Hadriana Lowenkron

item.title: Xi Unlikely to Bring CEOs to Summit Where Trump Is Seeking Deals
item.description: The highly anticipated summit between President Donald Trump and China’s Xi Jinping will bring together a robust gathering of US corporate leaders, but there will not be a comparable delegation of Chinese executives, raising questions about the prospects for the world’s two largest economies to strike new business deals this week.
item.dc:creator: Hadriana Lowenkron, Kate O'Keeffe, Michelle Jamrisko and Nectar Gan

item.title: If Poland Gets a US Base It’ll Be Called Fort Trump, Nawrocki Says
item.description: President Karol Nawrocki said he hopes the US will finalize plans to establish a permanent military base in Poland and, if it does, the compound will be christened ‘Fort Trump.’
item.dc:creator: Francine Lacqua and Zosia Wanat

item.title: Trump’s ‘Lavish Welcome’ for Xi Slammed by Key GOP Senator
item.description: Senate Armed Services Chairman Roger Wicker sharply criticized Donald Trump for the manner in which he plans to host Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington this week, marking a significant public break from a key member of the president’s own party just ahead of the high-stakes summit.
item.dc:creator: Erik Wasson

item.title: Trump Is Setting The UN Up To Fail
item.description: This year’s UN General Assembly in New York is consumed not only by the world’s multiplying conflicts but also by the search for a new secretary general, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Andreas Kluth says. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump, Burnham Discussed Bringing Up Jimmy Lai With China’s Xi
item.description: President Donald Trump and UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham discussed bringing up the detention of Hong Kong tycoon and democracy activist Jimmy Lai when the US leader meets China’s Xi Jinping later this week.
item.dc:creator: Josh Wingrove and Chloe Chaplain

item.title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily: Trump Addresses UN (Podcast)
item.description: President Trump said US officials had a “very good” meeting with Iranian representatives, a rare direct encounter that offers a fresh opportunity to restart talks to end the nearly seven-month war. Trump didn’t provide details on who participated in the meeting, but referred to his special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, who sat alongside the president. The US administration has signaled a renewed effort to end the war in the Middle East, with Trump claiming the conflict will end just after the November US midterm elections, if not before. Earlier on Tuesday in his UN address, Trump threatened to “annihilate” Iran if its officials don’t strike a deal. Meantime, President Trump dismissed calls for an international agreement to put guardrails around the development of artificial intelligence, brushing off concerns about the dangers of frontier models going rogue. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Japan’s Takaichi Pledges Ukraine Support in First Zelenskyy Meet
item.description: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi pledged to continue Japan’s support for Ukraine in her first summit meeting with Ukranian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
item.dc:creator: Alastair Gale

item.title: Trump Says US Team Met With Iranians at UNGA
item.description: President Trump said US officials had a “very good” meeting with Iranian representatives, a rare direct encounter that offers a fresh opportunity to restart talks to end the nearly seven-month war. Trump didn’t provide details on who participated in the meeting, but referred to his special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, who sat alongside the president. We get reaction from Bloomberg's Tyler Kendall & Nick Wadhams. Meantime, the shipping insurance industry has found itself at the forefront of the ongoing conflict. Axis CEO Vince Tizzio joins to discuss. Plus - Peloton CEO Peter Stern joins the show as the fitness powerhouse rolls out a new lineup of treadmills. All on the latest episode of "Bloomberg Businessweek Daily." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump Pressured by GOP Senator to Tap Home Heating Oil Reserve
item.description: Senator Susan Collins is calling on President Donald Trump to release supply from the Northeast Home Heating Oil Reserve to combat rising costs because of the Iran war and the Russia-Ukraine war.
item.dc:creator: Steven T. Dennis and Will Kubzansky

item.title: Finland President Stubb on Russia-Ukraine War and AI
item.description: Finland President Alexander Stubb says the Ukraine war has moved into a better position for Kyiv compared with a year ago, citing stronger military, political and financial footing. Speaking with Bloomberg's Annemarie Hordern during the United Nations General Assembly in New York, President Stubb also comments on the future of artificial intelligence. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Kamala Harris Helps El-Sayed Court Black Voters in Michigan Senate race
item.description: While Harris is a controversial figure, she remains wildly popular with a key part of the Democratic base.
item.dc:creator: Nancy Cook

item.title: Ex-DOJ Official Sees More False Claims Act Cases Getting Tossed
item.description: The US Justice Department has encouraged prosecutors to dismiss more lawsuits against companies brought by whistleblowers, and the former top deputy for the agency’s civil division expects the trend to continue.
item.dc:creator: Jimmy Jenkins and Chris Strohm

item.title: Big Take: What Trump, Xi Want From Their Summit
item.description: When Trump and Xi come face-to-face in Washington this week, each president will have his own agenda. But one thing is clear: they will have no choice but to cooperate on AI. Tap the link in bio to listen to the full episode of the Big Take Asia podcast. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump, Takaichi Discuss China in Meeting Before Xi’s US Trip
item.description: President Donald Trump and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi agreed to closely coordinate on issues related to China just days before a high-stakes trip to Washington by Chinese leader Xi Jinping, a Japanese government spokesman said.
item.dc:creator: Alastair Gale

item.title: Trump Says He’s Pushed for Fuel Export Ban Amid Price Crunch
item.description: President Donald Trump said he’s encouraged his advisers to support a ban on US diesel exports, with wars in Iran and Ukraine driving the fuel’s price to record levels.
item.dc:creator: Josh Wingrove and Jennifer A. Dlouhy

item.title: Republican Senator Calls for Investigation Into Trump Family
item.description: A Republican senator is calling for an investigation into the Trump family’s financial dealings — including demanding testimony from Donald Trump Jr. — in a sharp break with the president weeks before the midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Steven T. Dennis
